setup_search_keys: ↑/↓ Choose · Type to search · Enter Accept · Esc Back
ui_password_keys: Tab show/hide · Enter Accept · Esc Cancel
source: Path to the reviewed new checkout
local_tls: Turn local HTTPS on or off
name: IP or hostname (without http:// or port)
error: The operation did not finish. Check the indicated private log.
pending: An operation is pending. The proxy stays in maintenance; use Recover.
form_cancel_hint: Return without applying the form changes.
checks_warning: Some checks reported problems. Review the results.
dashboard_keys: ↑/↓ Select · ←/→ Column · Tab Next · Enter Open · Esc Exit
view_keys: ↑/↓ Scroll · PgUp/PgDn Page · Home/End · Enter/Esc Back
desc_stop: Stop every service of this installation.
desc_updates: New official Alfresco releases and component updates.
desc_self_update: Install a reviewed copy of the manager.
desc_maintenance: Services, HTTPS certificates and available versions; optional daily schedule.
desc_recover: Resume or undo an interrupted update.
desc_domains: Local addresses, HTTPS domains and ports.
desc_install: Install Alfresco Community with PostgreSQL, search, Share, Content App and HTTPS.
install_intro: Alfresco is not installed yet. It needs at least 8 GB of RAM and 15 GB free (recommended: 16 GB and a 50 GB disk).
environment_help: Local server: opened through its LAN IP. VPS: listens on 127.0.0.1 and is opened through an SSH tunnel until you add an HTTPS domain.
cancelled: Cancelled. No subsequent steps were applied.
restore_word: The database and certificates from before the update are restored into new volumes; documents are unchanged. Type RESTORE to confirm; Esc cancels.
confirm_edit_keys: Type RESTORE · Enter Confirm · Esc Cancel
confirm_files: SQL and certificates will be restored into new volumes.
confirm_update: Alfresco will stop, SQL will be backed up and the new release applied; the schema upgrades on start.
confirm_install: Official images will be downloaded and Alfresco created. The first start takes several minutes.
install_confirm_help: Install now starts installation. Cancel or Esc returns to the form.
install_form_intro: The newest official Alfresco Community bundle is installed. Edit what you need; «Install Alfresco» opens the final confirmation.
install_submit_help: Continue to the final confirmation; you can still return and edit the values.
install_cancelled: Installation cancelled. You can edit the values or leave the form.
confirm_docker: Install Docker Engine and Compose from the official repository.
confirm_settings: Apply the reviewed settings and verify access.
confirm_resume: Resume the pending operation from its recovery point.
confirm_schedule: Schedule daily checks. Updates require a manual action.
confirmation_help: Use ↑/↓ and Enter to confirm. Esc returns without starting this action.
form_intro: Select a field to edit. Review the summary before applying.
review_help: Check the values. Select a field to correct it, or confirm the action.
invalid_email: Enter a valid email or leave it empty.
field_help_bind: Server IP where the proxy listens. 127.0.0.1 only allows local or SSH-tunnel access; 0.0.0.0 every interface.
field_help_address: IP or name used to open Alfresco, without protocol or port.
field_help_http_port: HTTP port from 1 to 65535; different from the HTTPS port.
field_help_https_port: HTTPS port from 1 to 65535; different from the HTTP port.
field_help_storage_root: Absolute host folder for persistent data.
field_help_name: IP or domain without http://, https://, path or port.
field_help_email: Optional contact for the Let's Encrypt certificate account.
ports_existing: An existing panel was detected. Review ports before continuing.
error_help: Read the message and the private log. Enter or Esc returns to the menu.
desc_reset_password: Select an Alfresco account and set a new password.
password_user_help: Alfresco users. When you change admin, the manager stores the new password.
password_help: The password is sent to Alfresco through its API and never logged.
password_mismatch: Passwords do not match. Enter it again.
confirm_reset_password: The selected account password will change. Use the new password to sign in again.
password_reset_done: Password reset. You can now sign in with the new password.
domain_new_help: New address: enter the domain or IP you want to add. Saved addresses are preserved.
domain_directory_help: Saved addresses. Select one to manage it, or add another at the end of the list.
domain_directory_empty: There are no addresses of this type yet. Select Add to configure the first one.
domains_help_add_local: Manage server IPs and hostnames used from LAN or Tailscale; these are not client IPs.
domains_help_add_direct: Manage domains pointing to this server. Adding one requires DNS and inbound TCP 80/443.
domains_help_add_tunnel: View saved domains or add another for a manually installed cloudflared tunnel.
domains_help_remove: Removes an allowed address. Alfresco documents are kept.
domains_help_primary: Alfresco and Share use this URL to build links (and for Share CSRF protection).
domains_help_local_tls: Enable or disable a local certificate. Devices must trust Caddy's CA.
domains_help_ca: Export the root certificate to trust local HTTPS on your devices.
domains_help_network: Adjust the proxy listening IP and HTTP/HTTPS ports.
public_first_primary: The first public domain becomes the primary Alfresco address. Local access is kept.
tunnel_primary_saved: Domain saved as primary for links and checks. Local access is retained.
tunnel_help: Install and configure cloudflared manually. Preserve the public hostname and forward /.well-known/acme-challenge/ to the proxy.
direct_help: Point DNS to this server and allow TCP 80/443 to reach the proxy.
ca_help: Import this public CA on clients using local HTTPS.
updates_help: An SQL backup comes first; if anything fails, «Recover» restores the previous version.
no_updates: No version is available for this action.
components_help: Caddy is swapped online and rolled back if it fails. PostgreSQL gets patches within its major after an SQL backup.
maintenance_help: Checks services, HTTPS certificates and available versions. Never applies updates automatically.
self_update_help: Path to a downloaded and reviewed copy of the repository.
stop_help: Alfresco, Share, search, PostgreSQL and the proxy of this installation will stop.
exit_confirm_hint: Press Enter or Esc again to exit.
back_help: Return to the previous menu without changes.
updates_none: Alfresco and its components are up to date.
schedule_unavailable: Daily scheduling requires systemd; you can still check manually.
logs_help: Shows the latest 200 lines of the service. Esc returns to this list.
vps_loopback_set: VPS: listening IP and local address set to 127.0.0.1 (connect through an SSH tunnel).
field_help_publish: Yes: listen on every IP (0.0.0.0) with ports 80/443 so the certificate is issued directly.
desc_cleanup: Remove old images, volumes and revisions the installation no longer uses.
cleanup_help: Removes Docker images of earlier versions, volumes left after updating or rolling back and old configuration revisions. Active data is untouched.
cleanup_nothing: There are no old images, volumes or revisions to remove.
confirm_cleanup: The listed volumes, images and revisions will be permanently deleted. Data in use is not affected.
certificate_pending: The HTTPS certificate is not issued yet. Check DNS, ports 80/443 or the tunnel; Caddy keeps retrying.
field_help_version: Official Alfresco bundle (acs-deployment). The newest is recommended; an older one is useful to test updates.
desc_credentials: Application addresses and the stored admin password.
updates_scope: Before updating, Alfresco stops and an SQL backup is created. Documents are unchanged.
catalog_offline: GitHub could not be reached; showing the bundles packaged with the manager.
admin_password_help: Keep this password safe. You can show it again in «Accounts → Access credentials».
install_done: Alfresco is ready. Sign in to Share as admin with this password.
credentials_notice: Admin password stored by the manager.
admin_current_help: The stored admin password no longer works (it was changed in Share). Type the current one to store it.
install_next_https: Next step: add your HTTPS domain (or local HTTPS) in «Domains and access».
requirements_ok: The server meets the recommended requirements.
requirements_warning: You can install, but review the warnings.
requirements_blocked: The server does not meet the minimum; Alfresco could not work. Add resources and try again.
requirements_help: Minimum: 8 GB of RAM and 15 GB free. Recommended: 16 GB of RAM and a 50 GB disk.
req_memory_warning: It works; 16 GB gives more room for many users.
req_memory_unknown: Could not be measured; at least 8 GB are needed.
req_cpu_ok: More cores speed up start-up and conversions.
req_cpu_warning: With a single core Alfresco will be very slow.
req_disk_ok: Room for images, data and updates.
req_disk_warning: Alfresco fits; updates will need «Free up space» first. Recommended: a 50 GB disk.
req_disk_full: After installing it would exceed 85 %: search could not index.
req_disk_error: At least 15 GB free is needed (the installation takes about 12 GB).
req_data_disk_ok: Room to start; it grows with your documents.
req_data_disk_error: The data folder needs at least 5 GB free.
req_memory_low: It will probably not start for lack of memory (8 GB min.).
requirements_memory: Warning: with less than 8 GB of RAM Alfresco will probably not run. You may continue at your own risk.
